title: Birdwatching in Madeira: Seabirds and Endemic Birds Worth Finding
description: Where to see birds in Madeira: Cory's shearwaters at sea, the Trocaz pigeon in the laurel forest and the firecrest on levadas, plus when and how to look.
heroAlt: Madeira's dramatic green sea cliffs seen from the Atlantic

images.prompt: Wide landscape photograph of Madeira's steep green sea cliffs plunging into the deep blue Atlantic along the south coast near Cabo Girão, with a few seabirds gliding low over the water in soft morning light.
images.alt: Green sea cliffs on Madeira's south coast with seabirds over the Atlantic

images.prompt: A Cory's shearwater gliding low over the Atlantic swell off Madeira, wings stiff and tilted, with a cliff face blurred in the background in warm late light.
images.alt: A shearwater gliding over the sea off Madeira

images.prompt: A misty Madeira laurel forest trail at dawn with moss-covered trunks and a small bird perched on a branch, soft light filtering through the canopy.
images.alt: A small bird on a branch in Madeira's laurel forest
